name: Beni Madho Singh
role: Awadh taluqdar who fought the British
contribution: Beni Madho Singh, an Awadh taluqdar, led armed resistance against East India Company rule during the 1857 rebellion.
context: His resistance grew from the annexation of Awadh and the disruption of taluqdar authority. The Awadh theatre combined local landholding politics, courtly legitimacy, and military opposition to British rule.
impact: Beni Madho Singh represents the regional landed leaders who sustained resistance after the initial military revolt and made 1857 a wider political struggle in north India.
highlight: Awadh taluqdar who fought Company forces during the 1857 rebellion.
seoTitle: Beni Madho Singh: Awadh Taluqdar in the 1857 Rebellion

shortAnswer: Beni Madho Singh was an Awadh taluqdar who led regional resistance against the British during the 1857 rebellion.
